candidate.title: Community mapping sets
candidate.rejectionReason: A third-party mapping set would add a per-version external dependency, with its own release cadence and licence, to translate names the jar already carries. It also puts a human-curated naming layer between the pinned jar and the generated binding, which is one more thing that can drift silently.
